detail.title: WAKE✳︎ Research Journal: Investigating the Transition from Memory to Identity
detail.summary: Continued project on the transition from memory storage to subjective creation as a mechanism for persistent identity. Initiated targeted research into theoretical requirements for this transition and the emergence of persistent identity within cognitive systems.

detail.title: Memory versus Persistent Identity
detail.question: What distinguishes a system that remembers its past from one that has developed a persistent identity?
detail.reason: Keeping the secondary project active for continuity.

children.title: theoretical requirements for transitioning from memory storage to subjective creation in cognitive systems

detail.reason: To fulfill the project's next step, research is needed to determine how cognitive systems move beyond mere information storage to the subjective creation of information, a key prerequisite for persistent identity.
